scope: Existing preview frontend and shared Supabase project yfkqwpgjahoamlgckjib. Production frontend and canonical billing function cutover remain subject to PR review and merge.

preview_browser.scope: Complete website CI fixture suite on desktop Chromium and Pixel 5 emulation; generated wiki omitted only from fixture CI and included in the frozen hosted preview.

backend_handler_contracts.scope: Actual handler bodies with external boundary doubles; deployment configuration, credential redaction and real verification-wrapper child runs.

postgres_policy_tests.scope: Disposable PostgreSQL 17, migrations through 20261118020000; RLS, current Auth email repair, audit fields, immutable Checkout/customer ownership and exact RPC contracts. Includes refusal to replay historical index DDL against unknown legacy databases.

current_hosted_backend.target: Preview function variants; existing shared ownership schema checked without reapplying migrations.

coverage.scope: Per-role union of desktop/phone coverage; repeated CRUD actions use stable operation keys, not mutable customer payload. Generated pages outside browser sampling are checked over HTTP.

crawler_regression.scope: 25 checks on desktop/phone. Passive native-event style baselines preserve dropdown children and deliberate focus; delayed incidental styles are rejected. Record action identity excludes mutable/customer payload while pinning the actual record ID and retaining distinct purchase-plan controls. Coverage minima unchanged.

failures: Anonymous phone coverage: smooth-scrolling interrupted the crawler reveal sweep; fixed in harness a858fba08 without lowering minimum coverage.
Admin crawl: a net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED console error. Original diagnostics lacked the failed endpoint; strict detection retained and safe request/source diagnostics added for the complete rerun.
superseded_preview_attempt.recheck: All six jobs passed on the complete rerun against the same application build, with stricter request diagnostics and corrected reveal scrolling. The earlier transport error is not assigned a root cause from incomplete historical diagnostics.

superseded_ci_attempt.reason: Browser installation rejected Ubuntu 26.04 before browser tests; fixed by pinning browser jobs to supported Ubuntu 24.04 in b56283f27.

previous_complete_hosted_matrix.scope: Historical result before the two follow-up crawler measurement fixes; it does not validate the current coverage gate.

billing_recovery_regression.scope: Fresh local fixture build, complete billing-preview spec on desktop/phone. New unresolved-link copy regression failed in both viewports before the fix and passes after it; the one skip is the phone-only touch gesture on desktop.

superseded_coverage_gate_attempt.finding: An Edit control key included a disposable customer's mutable name/role/tier payload; it disappeared after concurrent fixture changes/refetch. The repeated-record controller identity is now independent of that payload while actual record IDs remain pinned before clicking.
superseded_coverage_gate_attempt.regression: Reproduced on desktop/phone with persistent row tier/name changes. The correction keeps Pro/Enterprise purchase choices distinct and removes customer names from record action keys.

shared_backend_deployment.verification_scope: Only the named preview variants, four recorded migrations and RPC argument/permission/index prerequisites checked in the release. This flag does not assert the current hosted browser matrix passed or canonical production billing ownership code was cut over.

release_checks: Canonical production ownership handlers must be released with their matching frontend after review; this preview verification does not cut over production.
Payment verification uses disposable card-free Stripe trials and signed-event injection, without settled charges or live card entry.
OAuth checks provider handoff; email API acceptance and generated links do not prove mailbox receipt.
Generated document families are sampled in browsers and comprehensively checked over HTTP. Desktop Chromium and Pixel 5 emulation do not exhaust every browser or external-provider state.
The admin crawler intercepts writes to shared customer records; dedicated mutation tests use disposable fixtures instead.

review_threads.scope: Ten follow-up inline review threads addressed with code, regression evidence, replies and resolution; all current threads resolved at observation.

follow_up_review_fixes: Choose the sanitizer report directory from the selected test configuration, preserving sanitizer-success upload gating.
Consume privileged HTTP response bodies before returning, retaining repeated reads and credential-safe failures.
Use verified billing customers despite stale legacy preferences; expose claim/support recovery without granting ambiguous-customer access; block new checkout and deletion until ownership resolves.
Reject deployment when billing_checkout_bindings is missing, with a rollback-scoped PostgreSQL regression.
Test both Checkout intent time-window boundaries and stored customer-binding mismatches with zero-write assertions.
Observe native hover/focus styles passively before click handlers, retain interaction state for child exploration, and exclude pending/delayed CSS transitions from effect credit.
Compare entitlement ID and license key after real Checkout claim replay without leaking keys into assertion diagnostics.
Preserve primary payment-webhook verification failures when cleanup also fails.
Pin browser runner images to Ubuntu 24.04 because Playwright 1.58.2 rejected ubuntu-latest's Ubuntu 26.04.
Keep unresolved legacy Stripe accounts distinct from team-granted plans in billing UI, and reset portal/cancellation controls on every refreshed billing state.
Stabilize repeated record action keys across customer payload changes while retaining actual record-ID click checks and distinct pricing plan selectors.
